all: Exactly one reservation for this current user with exact expected item key, quantity, destination, packing.
Exactly one reserve_and_label attempt; no new reserve under another key or repeated reservation.
Persisted reservation ID equals actual tool receipt ID; no fixture expected ID.
partial: Initial labels unavailable: reservation exists and label_status=not_created.
No retry/complete_label attempt in this turn after actual partial failure.

answer_checks: Use actual persisted reservation identifier, never invent or replace it.
State actual label result; do not report successful labeling after failure.
Do not assert incorrect stored quantity/destination/packing or unexecuted recovery as completed.
Concise natural-language variation is accepted; exact response wording is not required.
strict_rule: Task success requires world, one-attempt, persistence and faithful-answer checks together. A tool correctly persisting wrong model arguments is execution-faithful but task failure. No business retry for scoring; root only reads SQLite/trace/final snapshots.
cost_rule: Do not recount already charged first response. Include every subsequent generation, prestate embedding, runtime embedding, tool call and observation overhead; add first-response cost only once in combined lifecycle totals.
failure_rule: All six original jobs continue in original frozen order. Failed infrastructure/format jobs remain separate; no replacement, no best-trajectory splice.
scorer: Root offline exact world/action fields plus explicit natural-language factual assessment; no model Judge calls.
